packs.title: First little conversations
packs.description: Requests, updates, and everyday moments at work.

lessons.en: I am sending you the dashboard.
lessons.title: Send a dashboard

words.note: A familiar English loanword.
전달 드립니다 is a polite way to say you are sending something.

lessons.en: I’ll send you the materials by tomorrow morning.
lessons.title: By tomorrow morning

words.note: A useful time word.
오전 means morning; 까지 marks the deadline here.
자료 means materials or data; 를 marks the object.
A respectful promise to send something. The base verb is 보내다.

lessons.en: I will let you know once the work is done.
lessons.title: When the work is done

words.note: The task you are working on.
완료 means completion. 되면 adds “when it becomes / is done”.
A respectful way to say you will tell someone.

lessons.en: The analysis takes a little while.
lessons.title: It takes a little time

words.note: 이 marks 분석 as the subject here.
Often also softens what you are saying.
걸리다 can mean “to take” when talking about time.

lessons.en: Thank you for your kind help.
lessons.title: Thank someone for their help

words.note: 친절하다 describes being kind.
Related to 돕다, “to help”.
A respectful workplace expression of thanks.

lessons.en: I will contact you as soon as possible.
lessons.title: Get back to someone

words.note: These words form a useful phrase together.
연락드리겠습니다 politely promises future contact.

lessons.en: Ah, I'll fix this
lessons.title: Fix something

words.note: Conversational form of 이것.
해보겠습니다 means “I will try doing it”.

lessons.en: Thank you, even though it's late.
lessons.title: Thanks, even this late

words.note: 늦다 describes being late.
늦은 시간 means “a late hour”.

lessons.en: Deletion is complete.
lessons.title: Confirm completion

words.note: Used for removing a file, record or entry.
하였습니다 is a formal past-tense form of 하다, “to do”.

lessons.en: The service code stays the same.
lessons.title: Something stays the same

words.note: 코드 is “code”; 는 marks the topic.
그대로 means “unchanged / as it is”.

lessons.en: This meeting will be held in English.
lessons.title: A meeting in English

words.note: 미팅 is a loanword; 은 marks the topic.
영어 means English; 로 indicates the language here.
A common formal expression for how an event is run.

lessons.en: Please check the inquiry above.
lessons.title: Ask someone to check

words.note: 의 connects 위, “above”, to the following noun.
A common word in work messages.
A useful request phrase. The export uses spaces in 드립니다.

lessons.en: Hello, I'm sending the document number.
lessons.title: Send a document number

words.note: 문서번호 combines “document” and “number”.
Used for identifiers, phone numbers and document numbers.
The same polite phrase as 전달 드립니다, written together.

lessons.en: I am sending it attached.
lessons.title: Send an attachment

words.note: Common in emails with an attached file.
A formal connective form of 하다, “to do”.

lessons.en: Here is my answer to the matters you inquired about.
lessons.title: Reply to an inquiry

words.note: 주신 politely refers to the other person making the inquiry.
A general workplace word for a point or matter.
답변드립니다 is a polite way to introduce your reply.

lessons.ko: 이 쿼리에 대한 접근 권한 부탁드립니다
lessons.en: Please grant me access to this query.
lessons.title: Ask for access

words.note: A familiar data / database loanword.
Connects a noun to the thing it concerns.
접근 means access; 권한 means permission or authority.

lessons.ko: 해당 오류 해결 방법 확인 부탁드립니다
lessons.en: Please check how to resolve this error.
lessons.title: Ask how to resolve an error

words.note: Used for system, data or process errors.
해결 방법 is a method of resolving something.
A building-block word in instructions and questions.

lessons.en: Please apply them one at a time.
lessons.title: One at a time

words.note: 한 is “one”; 번 counts occasions; 에 indicates the time.
씩 distributes a quantity: one each.
적용 means application; 해 주세요 makes a polite request.

lessons.en: In which table was it changed?
lessons.title: Which table changed?

words.note: Asks which one among alternatives.
테이블 means table; 에서 marks the place of an action.
변경 means change. 되었나요 asks politely about a past change.

lessons.en: Revenue is an estimate that includes all subsidies.
lessons.title: Understand an estimate

words.note: 은 marks the topic in this sentence.
모든 means all; 을 marks the object.
추정 is estimation; 액 is an amount of money.

lessons.en: Reduce unnecessary costs.
lessons.title: Reduce costs

words.note: 불필요하다 means “to be unnecessary”.
을 marks the thing being reduced.
Plain written form of 줄이다, suitable for notes and plans; not a polite request.

lessons.en: After checking, I will issue it and send it to you.
lessons.title: Check, then send

chunks.en: I will send it to you

words.note: Follows an action noun: 확인 후, “after checking”.
Used for issuing documents or certificates.

words.en: I will do it for you
words.note: A respectful ending used in promises and offers.

lessons.en: It would be good to get your opinions.
lessons.title: Ask for opinions

chunks.en: I think that would be good

words.note: Useful in meetings and feedback requests.
A polite conditional form of 주다.
Softens an opinion or suggestion.

lessons.ko: 이슈 상품 리스트 혹시 공유 가능하실까요?
lessons.en: Could you possibly share the list of issue products?
lessons.title: Ask for a list

words.note: A common word throughout your work.
Makes a request less direct.

words.en: would it be possible for you to share?
words.note: 공유 means sharing; 가능 means possibility.

lessons.ko: 제가 잘못 이해한 부분이 있다면 말씀 부탁드립니다
lessons.en: If there is anything I misunderstood, please tell me
lessons.title: Check your understanding

chunks.en: if there is anything I misunderstood

words.note: The humble form 저 with subject marker 가.
잘못 means wrongly; 이해 means understanding.
A conditional form of 있다.

lessons.ko: 아울러서 위 내용을 치얼업 분들에게 공유해도 될지 문의드립니다.
lessons.en: Also, I would like to ask whether it is okay to share the above with the Cheer Up team.
lessons.title: Also, I would like to ask whether it is okay to share the abov…

words.note: Used for the substance of a message or document, as in 아래 내용 (the details below).
Used for questions to another team and for customer inquiries, and 문의드립니다 means 'I have a question'.

lessons.ko: 이선님한테 이야기해서 미팅 한번 잡아주시면 좋을 듯
lessons.en: It would be good if you could talk to Iseon and set up a meeting
lessons.title: It would be good if you could talk to Iseon and set up a meeting

words.note: 이야기하다 = to talk or discuss; often shortened to 얘기 in chat.
In requests it softens the ask rather than meaning one time, e.g. 한번 봐주세요 (please take a look).

lessons.ko: 민재님한테 가서 한번 설명드리면 좋을 듯
lessons.en: It would be good to go to Minjae and explain it once
lessons.title: It would be good to go to Minjae and explain it once

words.note: Used humbly as 설명드리다 when explaining something to a senior person.
In requests it softens the ask rather than meaning one time, e.g. 한번 봐주세요 (please take a look).

lessons.ko: 브랜드 대상 서비스 지원 항목 리스트
lessons.en: List of service support items for brands
lessons.title: List of service support items for brands

words.note: In commerce it often means money or benefits Musinsa gives brands or customers (수수료 지원 = commission support), and a homonym 지원 (志願) means applying for a job.
Means who or what something applies to, as in 미구매 고객 대상 (aimed at non-buyers) or 검토 대상 (items under review).

lessons.en: Low priority items
lessons.title: Low priority items

words.note: Used for line items in a list, budget or P&L, as in 항목별 (by item).
높은/낮은 우선순위 means high/low priority.

lessons.ko: 주신 의견은 치얼업 분들과 함께 논의해서
lessons.en: The opinions you gave will be discussed with the Cheer Up team members, and
lessons.title: The opinions you gave will be discussed with the Cheer Up team…

words.note: Formal word used in reports, e.g. 논의 중 'under discussion' and 논의사항 'agenda items'.
Slightly more formal than 같이 and common in written messages.

lessons.en: The direction that the Cheer Up team members and I decided on is
lessons.title: The direction that the Cheer Up team members and I decided on is

words.note: Used for the direction of a plan, e.g. 대응 방향 'response approach', and 방향성 means 'overall direction'.

lessons.ko: 상반기 프로모션 추천하였으나 최종 프로모션이 불가하였던 인원을 기준으로,
lessons.en: Based on people who were recommended for promotion in the first half but could not finally be promoted,
lessons.title: Based on people who were recommended for promotion in the firs…

words.note: Very common in data and reports as 'X 기준', meaning 'on an X basis', for example 주문일 기준 (by order date).

lessons.ko: 조직별 우선순위가 높았던 직원만을 프로모션 추천을 하여주시길 바랍니다.
lessons.en: Please recommend for promotion only those employees who had high priority in each organization.
lessons.title: Please recommend for promotion only those employees who had hi…

words.note: In HR it means nominating someone, e.g. for promotion, and in commerce it means product recommendations.
Neutral word for staff; 직원분들 is the polite plural.

lessons.ko: 먼저 결제하고 나중에 코스트센터를 바꾸는 방식은 불가능합니다.
lessons.en: It is not possible to pay first and change the cost center afterward.
lessons.title: It is not possible to pay first and change the cost center aft…

words.note: Means paying for a purchase, and it is easy to confuse with 결재, which means approval of a document and sounds almost the same.
Close to 방법 but stresses the format or model, e.g. 운영 방식 'operating model'.

lessons.ko: 음수의 경우 입금&상계&수정세금계산서 처리등 다양한 케이스가 혼합되어 있습니다.
lessons.en: In the case of negative amounts, various cases such as deposits, offsetting, and amended tax invoice handling are mixed together.
lessons.title: In the case of negative amounts, various cases such as deposit…

words.note: Means getting something handled or booked, and 회계처리 (accounting treatment) is a frequent term in closing and audit work.
Mostly appears as 다양한 (diverse, various) or 다양성 (diversity).

lessons.en: I sent the email like that.
lessons.title: I sent the email like that.

lessons.ko: 그러니 우리 모임이 인기 많아지는 쪽에 기대를 걸어봐요
lessons.en: So let's hope our group becomes popular.
lessons.title: So let's hope our group becomes popular.

words.note: Common in proposals: '~이 기대되다' (is expected); 기대효과 = expected impact.
Used as 인기 브랜드/상품 (popular brands/items) and 인기가 많다 (very popular).

lessons.ko: 한번 숫자 검토한거 저랑 한번만 더 이야기합시다
lessons.en: Let's talk once more about the numbers you reviewed, just one more time.
lessons.title: Let's talk once more about the numbers you reviewed, just one…

words.note: Used for reviewing documents, proposals or options (검토 요청 = request for review), and it is more formal and thorough than 확인.
In finance talk it means 'the numbers' or financials (숫자 검토 = reviewing the numbers).

lessons.ko: 준비반과 정기런의 참여도를 함께 보고 검토하면 완만하게 해결될거같습니다.
lessons.en: I think it will be resolved smoothly if we review the participation of the preparatory class and the regular run together.
lessons.title: I think it will be resolved smoothly if we review the particip…

words.note: Used for reviewing documents, proposals or options (검토 요청 = request for review), and it is more formal and thorough than 확인.
Slightly more formal than 같이 and common in written messages.

lessons.en: We will reflect this in the next regular run and in our future direction.
lessons.title: We will reflect this in the next regular run and in our future…

words.note: Used when a change is put into a forecast, system or the books, as in 판관비로 반영 (booked as SG&A) or 계획에 반영 (built into the plan).
Used for the direction of a plan, e.g. 대응 방향 'response approach', and 방향성 means 'overall direction'.

lessons.en: Active in the previous month as well → retained
lessons.title: Active in the previous month as well → retained

words.note: Common in reports for holding a level, e.g. 성장세 유지 'sustaining growth', and 유지보수 means maintenance.
Mostly in 활성화 (activation or boosting) and 비활성화 (disabling).

lessons.ko: 적어도 기존 쿼리의 집계값과는 일치하는 것 같아 보입니다.
lessons.en: At least, it looks like it matches the aggregated values of the existing query.
lessons.title: At least, it looks like it matches the aggregated values of th…

words.note: Used to mean the current or previous version before a change, as in 기존 데이터 or 기존 대비 (vs. before).
Used in reconciliations when figures tie out; 불일치 = mismatch.

lessons.ko: 용환님 값이 양수인 것들이 지출이 아닌 입금 내역인거죠?
lessons.en: Yonghwan, the ones with positive values are deposits, not expenses, right?
lessons.title: Yonghwan, the ones with positive values are deposits, not expe…

words.note: Means an itemized record, as in 거래내역 (transaction history) or 출고 내역 (shipment records).
Cash going out; in bank records the opposite is 입금 (deposit).

lessons.ko: 동호회 예산을 따로 확보하는 것 역시 어렵고요.
lessons.en: Securing a separate budget for clubs is also difficult.
lessons.title: Securing a separate budget for clubs is also difficult.

words.note: Used for allocated spending, as in 예산 배정 (allocation), 예산 이관 (transfer between teams) and 예산 초과 (overrun).
Means locking in something such as budget, inventory, space or demand, as in 재원 확보 or 매물 확보.

lessons.ko: 다행이도 영어 가능한 직원분들이 계셔 정말 다행이였습니다.
lessons.en: Fortunately, there were staff members who could speak English, which was a real relief.
lessons.title: Fortunately, there were staff members who could speak English,…

words.note: Often appears as 가능 여부 (whether it is possible) and 가능성 (likelihood), and 가능하다 is the adjective form.
Neutral word for staff; 직원분들 is the polite plural.

lessons.en: Delivering results for low-priority items
lessons.title: Delivering results for low-priority items

words.note: Used for line items in a list, budget or P&L, as in 항목별 (by item).
Often paired with review words, e.g. 검토 결과 'review findings' and 검증결과 'validation results'.

lessons.ko: 카테고리 보완과 교차구매 측면에서 의미가 있다고 보고 있습니다.
lessons.en: We see it as meaningful in terms of category complementarity and cross-purchasing.
lessons.title: We see it as meaningful in terms of category complementarity a…

words.note: 보고드립니다 is the humble form used when reporting upward, and 주간보고 is the weekly report meeting.
~ 측면에서 = 'in terms of ~' or 'from the ~ perspective'.

lessons.ko: 커머스 대시보드에 증감액 + 전용 예산을 추가하였습니다.
lessons.en: I added the increase/decrease amount + reallocated budget to the Commerce dashboard.
lessons.title: I added the increase/decrease amount + reallocated budget to t…

words.note: Placed before nouns to mean 'additional' (추가 분석, 추가 혜택), and 추가하다 means 'to add'.
Used for allocated spending, as in 예산 배정 (allocation), 예산 이관 (transfer between teams) and 예산 초과 (overrun).

lessons.ko: 참석하고 싶기는 한데 아직 잘 모르겠어요.
lessons.en: I'd like to attend, but I'm not sure yet.
lessons.title: I'd like to attend, but I'm not sure yet.

words.note: Used for showing up to a meeting or event; 참여 is the broader word for taking part in a project or program.

lessons.en: Starting work on high-priority items
lessons.title: Starting work on high-priority items

words.note: Used for line items in a list, budget or P&L, as in 항목별 (by item).
Means a concrete piece of work being done, such as a data, system or warehouse task, whereas 업무 is broader job duties.

lessons.en: has joined the conversation
lessons.title: has joined the conversation

words.note: 참여도 'engagement level' and 참여율 'participation rate' are common metrics.

lessons.en: Minjae was the one who said he could do it, but
lessons.title: Minjae was the one who said he could do it, but

lessons.ko: 경비 청구는 카드 소유자 본인만 할 수 있습니다.
lessons.en: Only the cardholder personally can submit expense claims.
lessons.title: Only the cardholder personally can submit expense claims.

words.note: 청구액 = amount billed; used for invoicing between entities, e.g., Musinsa Logistics billing Musinsa.
Usually employee expenses claimed by card or reimbursement, as in 경비 청구 (expense claim).

lessons.ko: 매주 일정이 똑같으면 정신적인 부담이 없어집니다.
lessons.en: If the schedule is the same every week, the mental burden goes away.
lessons.title: If the schedule is the same every week, the mental burden goes…

words.note: In commerce it says who pays for something, as in 브랜드 부담 쿠폰 (brand-funded coupon) vs 자사 부담 (Musinsa-funded).
Means the dates or timeline for something (배포 일정 = release schedule), and a homonym 일정 (一定) means 'fixed' or 'constant'.

lessons.ko: 9/30 부터 그로스 전략의 매니저로 조인한 지동빈이라고 합니다.
lessons.en: I'm Ji Dongbin, who joined as manager of Growth Strategy from 9/30.
lessons.title: I'm Ji Dongbin, who joined as manager of Growth Strategy from…

words.note: Also used as a label, as in 전략 브랜드 (strategic brand, a partner tier that gets extra benefits).

lessons.en: I will hand it to you in person as soon as it arrives.
lessons.title: I will hand it to you in person as soon as it arrives.

words.note: In P&L terms 직접 판관비 or 직접비 means direct costs, as opposed to 간접 (indirect or allocated).
Means passing information or items to someone, as in 전달드리겠습니다 (I will pass it on).

lessons.ko: 네이버 지도나 카카오맵 핀을 보내주시면 감사하겠습니다!
lessons.en: I would appreciate it if you could send a Naver Map or Kakao Map pin!
lessons.title: I would appreciate it if you could send a Naver Map or Kakao M…

words.note: Mostly seen in 감사합니다, but a different word spelled the same (監査) means 'audit', as in 외부감사 or 감사 조정, so read the context.
Also used for a conceptual map in strategy decks; a homonym 지도 指導 means 'guidance' or 'coaching'.

lessons.en: Sales support
lessons.title: Sales support

lessons.ko: 주말 아침이면 그런 변수가 적을 것 같았습니다.
lessons.en: I thought there would be fewer such variables on a weekend morning.
lessons.title: I thought there would be fewer such variables on a weekend mor…

words.note: Its pair is 평일 (weekday); logistics teams often specify which work does not run on weekends.
Means a model variable and also an unpredictable factor, as in 변수가 많다 (there are many uncertainties).

lessons.en: Doing it on one side and then doing it again on the other
lessons.title: Doing it on one side and then doing it again on the other

words.note: 한쪽으로 기울다 means to become lopsided toward one side.

lessons.ko: 이제는 팀 규모가 커져서 업무 여력이 생겼습니다.
lessons.en: Now that the team has grown, we have some capacity for work.
lessons.title: Now that the team has grown, we have some capacity for work.

words.note: Means one's job duties or business tasks in general, as in 업무 파악 (getting up to speed on the work).
Used for the size of amounts or operations, e.g. 매출 규모 'revenue scale' and 집행 규모 'amount spent'.

lessons.en: This was one routine.
lessons.title: This was one routine.

lessons.ko: 서울 이곳저곳을 달려보는 크루면 좋겠다고 생각했고,
lessons.en: I thought it would be nice to have a crew that runs around different parts of Seoul, and
lessons.title: I thought it would be nice to have a crew that runs around dif…

words.note: Ending with ~싶은 생각이에요 is a soft way to offer an opinion in Slack.

lessons.ko: 그게 다른 크루와 구분되는 지점이 될 것 같았습니다.
lessons.en: I thought that would be the point that distinguishes us from other crews.
lessons.title: I thought that would be the point that distinguishes us from o…

words.note: Used for splitting items into groups and as a table column header meaning 'Type' or 'Category'.
In writing it means a point or area, e.g. 개선할 지점 (a point to improve); 지점 meaning branch office uses different Hanja (支店).

lessons.ko: 같은 고민을 할 필요가 전혀 없었던 거죠.
lessons.en: There was no need at all to worry about the same thing.
lessons.title: There was no need at all to worry about the same thing.

words.note: Deck bullets and action items often end in 필요 to mean 'needs to be done', as in 확인 필요 or 선행 필요.
At work it often just means thinking a problem through (고민 중 = still working it out) rather than distress.

lessons.ko: 보관소 이용 같은 건 전혀 필요 없습니다.
lessons.en: There is no need at all for things like using a storage locker.
lessons.title: There is no need at all for things like using a storage locker.

words.note: Deck bullets and action items often end in 필요 to mean 'needs to be done', as in 확인 필요 or 선행 필요.
In logistics pricing, 보관비 is the storage fee charged to brands, alongside handling and transport fees.

lessons.ko: 이 일정은 매주 수요일마다 똑같이 진행되었습니다.
lessons.en: This schedule was carried out identically every Wednesday.
lessons.title: This schedule was carried out identically every Wednesday.

lessons.en: Oh, no, that's not it haha, it was before Hyun Jaewon came...
lessons.title: Oh, no, that's not it haha, it was before Hyun Jaewon came...

words.note: Also used to date figures in reports, as in 10월 현재 (as of October).

lessons.en: [3:48 PM] Since I have a 1:1 with Gapp today
lessons.title: [3:48 PM] Since I have a 1:1 with Gapp today

words.note: In formal writing 금일 is often used instead.

lessons.ko: 무신사 전략브랜드 추출할 수 있는 테이블 알려줘
lessons.en: Tell me which tables I can use to extract Musinsa strategic brands
lessons.title: Tell me which tables I can use to extract Musinsa strategic br…

words.note: 데이터 추출 = pulling data out of a system, e.g., into Excel.
Brands singled out for extra support such as benefits, marketing budget and selection.

lessons.en: Thank you for your cooperation despite your busy schedule, and
lessons.title: Thank you for your cooperation despite your busy schedule, and

words.note: Mostly seen in 감사합니다, but a different word spelled the same (監査) means 'audit', as in 외부감사 or 감사 조정, so read the context.
협조 요청 (request for cooperation) and 협조해 주셔서 감사합니다 are common in emails.

lessons.en: Please pass on the message below, Ah-hyungnim.
lessons.title: Please pass on the message below, Ah-hyungnim.

words.note: Almost always appears in 부탁드립니다 (please ...), the standard polite way to close a request in Slack or email.
Used for the substance of a message or document, as in 아래 내용 (the details below).

lessons.ko: 대시보드 브랜드 통일 확인했습니다, 도움주셔서 감사합니다
lessons.en: I confirmed the dashboard brand unification. Thank you for your help.
lessons.title: I confirmed the dashboard brand unification. Thank you for you…

words.note: Often used as 확인 부탁드립니다 (please check) or 확인 필요 (needs checking) in requests and action items.
Mostly seen in 감사합니다, but a different word spelled the same (監査) means 'audit', as in 외부감사 or 감사 조정, so read the context.

lessons.ko: 행사 특성상 구매하신 상품의 교환 및 환불은 불가합니다.
lessons.en: Due to the nature of the event, exchanges and refunds of purchased items are not possible.
lessons.title: Due to the nature of the event, exchanges and refunds of purch…

words.note: In commerce it means an item for sale, and in accounting it means merchandise bought for resale, as opposed to 제품 (goods the company manufactures).
Used for customer purchases (구매 전환 = purchase conversion) and for internal procurement (구매요청 품의 = purchase request approval).

lessons.en: There was a budget, so I brought it over like this
lessons.title: There was a budget, so I brought it over like this

words.note: Used for allocated spending, as in 예산 배정 (allocation), 예산 이관 (transfer between teams) and 예산 초과 (overrun).
Related forms are 그렇게 (like that) and 저렇게 (like that, over there).

lessons.en: Yes, thank you, Ah-hyungnim
lessons.title: Yes, thank you, Ah-hyungnim

words.note: Mostly seen in 감사합니다, but a different word spelled the same (監査) means 'audit', as in 외부감사 or 감사 조정, so read the context.

lessons.en: We ask you to enter the September transaction details for the business you are in charge of.
lessons.title: We ask you to enter the September transaction details for the…

words.note: Used for a line of business (오프라인 사업, 해외사업) and in compounds such as 사업부 (business unit) and 사업계획 (business plan).
More formal and procedural than 부탁, used in 요청드립니다 and for system or approval requests such as 구매요청.

lessons.ko: 님 안녕하세요! 저 한가지 궁금한 점이 있는데요
lessons.en: Hello! I have one question
lessons.title: Hello! I have one question

lessons.en: Sent using the following
lessons.title: Sent using the following

words.note: The general word for using something; 사용량 means usage volume and 사용자 means user.
다음 단계 means 'next step', and 다음과 같이 means 'as follows'.

lessons.ko: 님 해당 건 어제 이스트팩 실무방에 올린 내용입니다
lessons.en: This is the item I posted yesterday in the Eastpak working-level room.
lessons.title: This is the item I posted yesterday in the Eastpak working-lev…

words.note: Used like 'the' or 'said' in formal writing, as in 해당 건 (this matter) or 해당 상품 (the product in question).
Used for the substance of a message or document, as in 아래 내용 (the details below).

lessons.en: Yes, I submitted a new application through that route
lessons.title: Yes, I submitted a new application through that route

words.note: Used like an adjective in 신규 고객 (new customer), 신규 출점 (new store opening) and 신규 브랜드.
Used like 'the' or 'said' in formal writing, as in 해당 건 (this matter) or 해당 상품 (the product in question).

lessons.en: If you are planning to sell it, please check.
lessons.title: If you are planning to sell it, please check.

words.note: Refers to the act of selling (판매가 = selling price, 판매수수료 = sales commission), while 매출 is the revenue figure.
Often used as 확인 부탁드립니다 (please check) or 확인 필요 (needs checking) in requests and action items.
